periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Near-vertical orientation with a slight inward tilt at the superior pole, approximately 80 degrees relative to the horizontal facial axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated oval; the vertical axis is approximately 2.5 times longer than the horizontal axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced downward elongation, with the distance from the centroid to the inferior tip exceeding the distance to the superior tip.

dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Thick lateral bands, occupying approximately 40% of the visible vertical span of the torso at the flanks.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide gap between ear regions, approximately 1.5 to 2 times the width of an individual ear region.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smooth convex curvature along the superior boundary with no visible flattening.
